Speaker: Lira
Text: The sky here doesn't have stars. Just light — endless, shifting light that never quite becomes anything.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I've been counting days by the way the crystals hum. Higher pitch means morning, I think. I'm not sure anymore.

Speaker: Lira
Text: Sometimes I hear Dad's voice. Just echoes. The Ethereal Realm is full of echoes — memories that don't belong to anyone.

Speaker: Lira
Text: But I know he's looking for me. Dad doesn't give up. He never gives up.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I just have to hold on a little longer. I can do that. I have to.
